i01.mp3.text: Not so very long from now, people stopped building things... and started growing them.

i02.mp3.text: A tiny seed could hold a whole design. Plant it, and the land would grow into its shape, block by block by block.

i03.mp3.text: Nature and machines grew into each other. Trees grew bark of carbon lattice, and leaves of solar film that drank the sunlight.

i04.mp3.text: Vines carried data like little rivers of light. The beaches turned to mirror sand...

i05.mp3.text: ...and deep in the ocean, the kelp grew into servers, humming softly in the blue.

i06.mp3.text: Then, one day, the growers went quiet. Nobody is quite sure where they went.

i07.mp3.text: But the wild kept on growing.

i08.mp3.text: And now, you're awake. You have a fabricator kit, and a suit that runs on light.

i09.mp3.text: When the sun goes down, your power starts to droop, so build somewhere bright before the night comes.

i10.mp3.text: This whole world is waiting for someone to look after it. Go on, grower. Plant your seed.

n01.mp3.text: The sun is going down soon. Build a little shelter, and light it up!
